onboarding_step6_body: Give your scooter a name and pick a colour.
seat_alert_body: The seatbox is open. “Lock anyways” sends two ordinary lock requests. Older firmware may still wait about 30 seconds, then take about 5 seconds to shut down.
home_lock_request_sent: Lock requests sent. Check the scooter’s status.
home_lock_request_incomplete: Lock request sequence incomplete. The first request may already have started waiting or shutdown. Check the scooter’s status; no request was replayed.
handlebar_lock_waiting: Turn the handlebars fully left while the scooter shuts down. The steering lock has a limited positioning window; there is no need to switch the scooter off and on again. Check the lock status on the scooter.
system_info_failed: Could not read versions. Check the connection and try again.
